title: Jingle Bells
lyrics_original: In a one horse open sleigh
What fun it is to laugh and sing
Oh, what fun it is to ride
In a one horse open sleigh
Oh, what fun it is to ride
In a one horse open sleigh
I thought I'd take a ride
The horse was lean and lank
We got into a drifted bank
Oh, what fun it is to ride
In a one horse open sleigh
Oh, what fun it is to ride
In a one horse open sleigh yeah

bible_verses.telugu: మనము కలకనినవారివలె నుంటిమి మన నోటి నిండ నవ్వుండెను మన నాలుక ఆనందగానముతో నిండియుండెను. అప్పుడుయెహోవా వీరికొరకు గొప్పకార్యములు చేసెనని అన్యజనులు చెప్పుకొనిరి.
bible_verses.english: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, 'The Lord has done great things for them.'

bible_verses.telugu: సంతోషముగల మనస్సు ఆరోగ్యకారణము. నలిగిన మనస్సు ఎముకలను ఎండిపోజేయును.
bible_verses.english: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

bible_verses.telugu: మీలో ఎవనికైనను శ్రమ సంభవించెనా? అతడు ప్రార్థనచేయవలెను; ఎవనికైనను సంతోషము కలిగెనా? అతడు కీర్తనలు పాడవలెను.
bible_verses.english: Is anyone among you in trouble? Let them pray. Is anyone happy? Let them sing songs of praise.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for the wonderful gift of laughter and the pure joy that brightens our winter days. Fill my heart with Your gladness today, and let my happiness overflow into songs of gratitude to You. Help me to carry Your warmth and light to everyone I meet this season. May my lighthearted joy reflect the deep, lasting peace found in Your presence. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, thank You for the wonderful gift of laughter and the pure joy that brightens our winter days. devotional.reflection_english: Jingle Bells captures the simple, radiant joy that comes from embracing God's delightful creation and the warmth of shared laughter. Scripture reminds us that a cheerful heart is good medicine and that our happiness finds its highest purpose when turned toward the Giver of all good gifts. As you sing this familiar seasonal song, allow the lighthearted rhythm to lift your spirits and refresh your soul. Let it be a gentle invitation to celebrate the pure joy Jesus brings into our daily lives and to share His gladness with those around us.
